title.en: The End of the War in Heaven

texts.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]帝国最终在这场决定星系霸权的战争中昂首胜出。落败的先祖文明已被宿敌完全吞并，现在[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName]睥睨星河，主宰地位无可撼动。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这种新的秩序能持续多久呢？
texts.en:
After a long and fierce conflict, the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] have emerged victorious in the struggle for control over the galaxy. The defeated ancient empire has been fully annexed by their old rival, and the [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetSpeciesName] now stand triumphant as the undisputed dominant power in the galaxy.

For now, an uneasy peace reigns, but how long can this new order last?

texts.zh: [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]再次君临整片星系的消息似乎没有被别的失落帝国无视。[From.GetSpeciesName]对这一消息的不安尤为强烈。这两位先祖文明是亘古的宿敌，尽管由于某些原因他们的仇恨在漫长的历史中稍有褪色，然而[FirstSleeper.GetName]的突然觉醒点燃了古老的仇恨并激起了对抗行动。[From.GetName]已从沉睡中醒来，他们将以整个星系为战场延续远古的对决。
texts.en: The return of the [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] to the galactic scene has not gone unnoticed by the other Fallen Empires present in our galaxy. The [From.GetSpeciesName] in particular appeared most agitated at the news. It seems that these two proud nations are ancient rivals, and though the reasons for their rivalry has long since faded into history, the sudden reawakening of the [FirstSleeper.GetName] has enflamed old animosities and triggered a counter-reaction. The [From.GetName] have roused themselves from their slumber to face their old rivals, with the whole galaxy as their battleground.

label.zh: 这对我们来说意味着什么呢？
label.en: What will this mean for us all?

texts.zh:
自从[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]和他们的对手[From.GetSpeciesName]觉醒后，这两个巨人一直在为争夺影响力展开零星的冲突，以试探彼此的实力。这最终导致了冲突的一连串升级，终于，在某个遥远的恒星系中[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]舰队和他们的[From.GetSpeciesName]对手爆发了一场公开的舰队战。这次冲突现在演变为[FirstSleeper.GetName]与[From.GetName]之间的全面战争。

每一方都派遣了一名代表去往年轻的种族，承诺厚赏加入他们的人并严惩反对他们的人。选择支持任意一方都意味着放弃我们的主权，但维持中立可能更加危险，除非我们可以找到其他中立国家来与我们合作。
texts.en:
Ever since the awakening of the [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] and their ancient [From.GetSpeciesName] rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might. This has resulted in a series of increasingly terse confrontations, finally erupting in an open battle between a [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] fleet and their [From.GetSpeciesName] counterparts in a remote system. The conflict has now escalated into full-blown war between the [FirstSleeper.GetName] and the [From.GetName].

Each side has sent a representative to the younger races, promising great rewards for those who join them in their war and terrible punishments for those who choose to stand against them. Choosing either side in this conflict will mean giving up our independence, but remaining neutral may be even more dangerous unless we can find other neutral empires to stand by our side.

label.zh: 在这场斗争中我们不会站在任意一边。
label.en: We will not take sides in this conflict.

label.zh: 他们都将败在我们手下！
label.en: They will both fall to our might!

label.zh: 作为附属国，这不是由我们来决定的。
label.en: As a subject nation, it is not up to us to decide.

title.en: The End of the War in Heaven

texts.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，天堂之战以双方僵持不下的局面而告终。[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]与[WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName]已经签署了停火协议，将舰队撤回了各自边境。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这次休战能持续多久呢？
texts.en:
After a long and fierce conflict, the War in Heaven has ended with neither side able to achieve dominance over the other. The [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] and [WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName] have signed a ceasefire and withdrawn their fleets back to their own borders. 

For now, an uneasy peace reigns over the galaxy, but how long can this truce last?

texts.zh:
自从[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]以及他们的宿敌[From.GetSpeciesName]觉醒以来，这两个巨人总会偶尔爆发小规模冲突，或者相互施展诡谋以争夺影响力，希望借此试探对方的实力。这样的行为导致了一系列逐渐升温的对峙，最终演变成在某个遥远的星系一支[FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName]舰队和他们的[From.GetSpeciesName]对手爆发了公开的交火。这一冲突现在已经升级成为[FirstSleeper.GetName]和[From.GetName]之间的全面战争。

双方都勒令星海帝国必须立刻解散，其独立的成员国必须在战争中选择一边。今天的稍早时刻，[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院发表了讲话，态度明确地拒绝了这一无理要求。星系目前陷入了一场规模庞大的三方战争，其规模之大，前所未有，闻所未闻。
texts.en:
Ever since the awakening of the [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] and their ancient [From.GetSpeciesName] rivals, the two giants have been at odds, skirmishing and jockeying for influence, probing each others' might. This has resulted in a series of increasingly terse confrontations, finally erupting in an open battle between a [FirstSleeper.GetSpeciesName] fleet and their [From.GetSpeciesName] counterparts in a remote system. The conflict has now escalated into full-blown war between the [FirstSleeper.GetName] and the [From.GetName].

Both sides are demanding the immediate dissolution of the Galactic Imperium and for its individual members to pick a side in the war. Earlier today, the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] addressed the Imperial Senate and categorically rejected their demands. The galaxy now finds itself in a massive three-way war on a scale never before witnessed.

label.zh: 这将成为帝国的荣光时刻！
label.en: This shall be the Imperium's finest moment!

texts.zh: 先祖帝国间的战争以一方被击败而结束，但这并不是他们的宿敌所为。也许是大战消耗了他们的实力，亦或是单纯因为年轻种族们的实力，古老的帝国最终毁灭于他们眼中的弱小种族，这完全改变了局势。现在的问题是，[RemainingAwakened.GetName]能否避免踏上他们宿敌的后尘？还是说这标志着星系迎来了新的纪元？
texts.en: The war between the ancients has ended with the destruction of one of the combatants - but not at the hands of their old rival. Whether it was due to the war weakening them or simply due to the strength of the younger races, the destruction of an elder empire at the hands of their supposed lessers has changed the situation considerably. Now the question remains - will the [RemainingAwakened.GetName] be able to avoid the fate of their ancient foe, or does this defeat signal the dawn of a new age in the galaxy?

texts.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的兵燹之中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有一些物种和我们一样，保持了中立的姿态，但如果战事蔓延到我们的领地，我们就只能独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁。我们已经收到了其他帝国的通讯，他们决定建立一个不结盟组织，明确挑起反抗战争双方的大旗。由于我们的军事实力与影响力，他们决定邀请我们成为这支联盟势力的盟主。我们一旦接受，就几乎确定会同时跟两大觉醒的帝国开战，但至少我们还有盟友支援，不用独自面对两大先祖帝国的威胁。
texts.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a League of Non-Aligned Powers with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. Due to our military might and influence, we have been asked to lead this league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

texts.zh: 先祖帝国大战之间，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁了。我们收到了其他帝国的通讯，他们决定建立一个不结盟组织，明确挑起反抗战争双方的大旗。鉴于我们已是一个强大联邦，[Root.GetAllianceName]的领袖中的一员，他们决定请我们扩充自己现有的联盟以组建预想中的组织。接受请求基本意味着同觉醒的帝国们开战，但相比独抗强敌我们至少能与盟友并肩战斗了。
texts.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a League of Non-Aligned Powers with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. As we are already the leaders of a powerful federation, the [Root.GetAllianceName], we have been asked to expand our alliance to form the proposed league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

texts.zh:
在先祖帝国之间的兵燹之中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有一些物种和我们一样，保持了中立的姿态，但如果战事蔓延到我们的领地，我们就只能独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁。我们已经收到了其他帝国的通讯，他们决定建立一个不结盟组织，明确挑起反抗战争双方的大旗。

由于我们是现任星海监管人，他们决定邀请我们成为这支联盟势力的盟主。我们一旦接受，就几乎确定会同时跟两大觉醒的帝国开战，但至少我们还有盟友支援，不用独自面对两大先祖帝国的威胁。
texts.en:
Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of fighting the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. We have been contacted by representatives from other empires about the idea of creating a League of Non-Aligned Powers with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war.

As we are the current Galactic Custodians, we have been asked to lead this league. Accepting would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

label.en: No, it is simply too dangerous.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]正式申请加入不结盟组织。
texts.en: The [From.GetName] have formally requested to join the League of Non-Aligned Powers.

label.en: We will be glad to have them!
No, we do not need them.

texts.zh: 很快，先祖帝国就意识到了不结盟组织的存在。双方都派出了代表前往[Root.Capital.GetName]，要求解散联盟，并要求所有成员在这场战争中选边站队。我们自然是拒绝了，而今早，[FirstSleeper.GetName]与[SecondSleeper.GetName]都发布了与我们开战的公告。
texts.en: It did not take long for the ancients to take notice of the League of Non-Aligned Powers. Representatives from both warring powers have come to [Root.Capital.GetName] demanding the dissolution of the league, and for its members to choose sides in the war. Naturally, we refused, and as of this morning we are now in a state of war with both the [FirstSleeper.GetName] and the [SecondSleeper.GetName].

label.zh: 你们两个给老子滚出这个星系！
label.en: Get the hell out of our galaxy, both of you!

texts.zh: 在经历漫长而残酷的冲突后，这场因两个先祖帝国间的摩擦而起的战争以它们的双双覆灭告终。曾经拥有强大古代科技且自负高傲的巨人们沦为了历史尘埃，星系迎来了崭新的黎明，新兴物种将书写他们自己的命运。
texts.en: After a long and fierce conflict, the war that begun as a battle between two ancient empires has ended in the destruction of both. For all their ancient technological might, the arrogance and inflexibility of these ancient giants proved their undoing, and now they are gone, reduced to no more than another set of broken ruins of the past. A new age dawns on the galaxy, and from now on the fate of the younger races will be entirely their own to decide.

label.en: This will be the age of the [Root.GetName].

texts.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的大战之中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有一些物种和我们一样，保持了中立的姿态，但如果战事蔓延到我们的领地，我们就只能独自面对来自先祖帝国的威胁。在[From.GetName]的领导下，不结盟组织成立了，其目标是对抗挑起战火的先驱者帝国，加入这个联盟就意味着要和战争双方觉醒的失落帝国同时开战，但至少加入这个联盟的中立者们不用再孤军奋战了。
texts.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. A League of Non-Aligned Powers has formed under the leadership of the [From.GetName] with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war. Joining this league would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

texts.zh: 先祖帝国大战之间，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自先驱帝国的威胁了。[From.GetName]奋勇当先，宣布其联盟将作为不结盟组织挑起反抗战争双方的大旗，并邀请其他中立国团结在他们的旗帜下。加入这一组织基本意味着同觉醒的失落帝国们开战，但相比独抗强敌我们至少能与盟友并肩战斗了。
texts.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. The [From.GetName] has boldly taken the initiative, declaring their alliance a League of Non-Aligned Powers seeking to oppose both sides in the war, and inviting other neutral nations to rally behind their banner. Joining this league would almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we would have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

texts.zh: 先祖帝国大战之间，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自先驱帝国的威胁了。[From.GetName]，我们联邦的主席，已将我们的共同体重新命名为不结盟组织，挑起了反抗战争双方的大旗。建立这一组织基本意味着同觉醒的帝国们开战，但相比独抗强敌我们至少能与盟友并肩战斗了。
texts.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the elder menace alone if the war should come their way. The [From.GetName], our federation's President, has renamed our union as the League of Non-Aligned Powers and declared our goal to be opposing both sides in the war. Forming this league will almost certainly mean war with the awakened empires, but at least we have allies to stand by our side instead of facing them alone.

label.zh: 我们会对那些老骨头的暴政说不！
label.en: We shall oppose the tyranny of the elders!
No, it is simply too dangerous.

label.zh: 我们不能支持这样的行动方针。
label.en: We cannot support this course of action.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]已经批准我们加入不结盟组织，现在我们将和其他中立者一起抵抗这些先祖帝国的威胁。
texts.en: We have been accepted into the League of Non-Aligned Powers by the [From.GetName], and now we will stand together against the menace of the elder empires.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]拒绝了我们加入不结盟组织的请求，现在我们只能独自抵抗先祖帝国的威胁了。
texts.en: Our request to join the League of Non-Aligned Powers was refused by the [From.GetName], and now we will have to stand alone against the menace of the elder empires.

texts.zh: 在先祖帝国之间的战争中，并非所有的年轻物种都选择了其中一方。比如我们就保持了中立，但这意味着我们要独自面对觉醒帝国的威胁。以在战争中抵抗各边势力为目标，不结盟组织在[From.GetName]的领导下成立了。
texts.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the awakened menace alone if the war should come their way. A League of Non-Aligned Powers has formed under the leadership of the [From.GetName] with the explicit goal of opposing both sides in the war.

texts.zh: 并非所有的年轻物种都选择了先祖帝国的中途中站队。有些，比如我们，保持了中立；但倘若战争的天平朝一方倾斜，我们恐怕就要独自面对来自觉醒帝国的威胁了。[From.GetName]奋勇当先，宣布其联盟将作为不结盟组织挑起了反抗战争双方的大旗，并邀请其他中立国团结在他们的旗帜下。
texts.en: Not all of the younger races chose to join with either side in the war raging between the elder empires. Some, like ourselves, have remained neutral, but are facing the prospect of facing the awakened menace alone if the war should come their way. The [From.GetName] has boldly taken the initiative, declaring their alliance a League of Non-Aligned Powers seeking to oppose both sides in the war, and inviting other neutral nations to rally behind their banner.
